summary: Maury County, TN tower; in 1955 the state planned one of twelve 80-ft steel towers for this site; listed extant in 2014 and standing per Landforms; build date and access unconfirmed.

facts.design: Steel lookout tower from the state's 1955 purchase of twelve 80-foot steel towers; Theta's own model and height not confirmed

events.note: State bought twelve 80-foot steel towers; News-Democrat said one was to be erected at Theta before early winter (planned; completion not confirmed in sources read)
Listed among extant Tennessee fire towers as of March 26, 2014

evidence.supports: Agency is the Tennessee Division of Forestry
In October 1955 the state bought twelve 80-foot steel towers, one to be erected at this site before early winter, for about $36,000
evidence.quote: October 7, 1955: The state purchased twelve 80-foot steel lookout towers, one of which is to be erected at this point before early winter, at a cost of approximately $36,000.

evidence.supports: The 1955 report is attributed to the News-Democrat
Most TDF fire towers were built between the late 1940s and about 1960
evidence.quote: the majority of the TDF’s fire lookout towers were constructed during the period between the late 1940s and ca. 1960

evidence.supports: Document's list of extant towers is dated March 26, 2014
evidence.quote: Extant Tennessee Fire Towers as of March 26, 2014

evidence.supports: Theta is in Maury County on the extant list
The document's only mention of Theta is its extant-list entry, which gives no build date
Tower is listed as standing, Maury County, elevation 1,041 ft, TDF 7-3
The listing has no date of its own; the page carries a revision stamp dated 8 January 2026

sources.title: Tennessee Division of Forestry Fire Lookout Towers, 1933 to 1975 (National Register multiple property document)

notes_for_editor: Build date is not confirmed. The only 1955 source is a newspaper line, quoted by Forest Lookouts, saying one tower was to be erected here; no completion notice was found. The brief's height_m 24.4 is the 80-foot purchase type, not a measured height for Theta, so it is left out of facts. No staffing, fire history, access or visit information was found in the sources read, so those keys are omitted. Agency and District 7 come from the Forest Lookouts page. Searches: 2 (websearch.py). Page reads: about 4 cached pages plus the MPS PDF. Untried lead: 1955-56 Maury County newspaper coverage or Tennessee State Library and Archives records for the completion date.
